contentBlocks.text: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਨ ਬਾਰੇ ਲਿਖਿਆ। (You've written about family and your day.) Today, a cultural story: your favorite family tradition or celebration.

Three new words: ਤਿਉਹਾਰ (tyohar, festival/celebration), ਖੁਸ਼ੀ (khushi, happiness), and ਮਨਾਉਣਾ (manauna, to celebrate). Think of a tradition or celebration your family takes part in — it could be a festival, a birthday, or a special family gathering. Write 2-3 sentences describing it: what is it called, what do you do, and how does it make you feel? Try starting with: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਸੰਦੀਦਾ ਤਿਉਹਾਰ... (My favorite celebration...).

You just wrote a real cultural story about your own family's traditions — exactly the kind of writing this course is building toward. Tomorrow we'll combine everything from this week into one complete piece.

objectives: Learn 3 new vocabulary words: ਤਿਉਹਾਰ, ਖੁਸ਼ੀ, ਮਨਾਉਣਾ
Write 2-3 sentences describing a personal family tradition or celebration
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's vocabulary (family, daily routine).
2. Introduce today's 3 new words and the example sentence starter.
3. Discuss real family traditions the child can draw on before writing.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: combining everything into one finished piece.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to describe the tradition in English first, then help translate 1-2 key sentences into Punjabi
Ready for more: ask them to add a sentence explaining WHY the tradition matters to their family, not just what happens
All Gurmukhi words/sentences used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਤਿਉਹਾਰ = festival/celebration. 2. ਖੁਸ਼ੀ = happiness. 3. ਮਨਾਉਣਾ = to celebrate.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Addresses the course's 'cultural stories' description directly, giving the child a genuine, personally meaningful writing topic that also reinforces this week's paragraph-structure and vocabulary-expansion goals.

generationData.instructions: Write 2-3 sentences about a favorite family tradition or celebration, using ਤਿਉਹਾਰ, ਖੁਸ਼ੀ, or ਮਨਾਉਣਾ.
